name: Perito Moreno Glacier
shortStory: Perito Moreno is one of the rare advancing glaciers, famous for calving ice walls into turquoise water.
bullets: Part of Los Glaciares National Park

discoveries.hook: Its cracking ice sounds like distant thunder.
